Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human GnRH receptor (CHEMBL1855). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Left join docs on assays.doc_id to get pubmed_id or doi. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Filter by target tid for CHEMBL1855, standard_type IC50, and require canonical_smiles not null and (pubmed_id not null or doi not null). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows (no distinct). Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
